rule_text: Canonical content records use UUIDv5. Search queries and result rows link to UUIDv7 research sessions; captures, claims, evidence and verification observations use UUIDv7 event identifiers.
Shared recipe content contains portable natural-language clauses and provider-neutral constraints; any target-specific rendering choices live in an optional, separately verified adapter profile.
Every new historical claim must reference at least one source and one supporting evidence record.
Historical catalog facts, curator visual readings, user hypotheses, and creative proposals use distinct status values.
Each recipe weight is non-negative, the total is exactly one within the declared decimal precision, and component feature scores are in [0,1].
A style score may be used only in [0,1] and with an axis definition and calibration status.
A difference of two [0,1] scores is in [-1,1]; coordinates copied without raw scores remain provisional.
Similarity and distance relations must have causal_claim=false. Influence requires a separate source-backed claim.
A generated visual proposal must set historical_object=false and must not be presented as the historical artifact.
WCAG contrast thresholds apply only to the criteria and digital content types defined by WCAG 2.2.
Search result receipt and page-text retrieval are stored as separate states; timeout pages are not marked deep-read.
Visual quality, cultural interpretation, material fidelity and usability require human review.
